message.content:
This editorial illustration features a stylized portrait of a man, from the chest up, rendered in shades of deep blue, purple, and gray. He wears a collared white shirt and covers most of his face with his right hand, though his grinning mouth and one glowing, golden-yellow eye are visible through the gaps between his fingers. His skin appears smooth and slightly reflective.

At the top, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large red letters against a black background. Smaller white text below it reads "ENAK DIBACA." To the right, "EDISI KHUSUS 10 TAHUN JOKOWI" appears in white. The main headline, "NAWADOSA JOKOWI," is written in bold white capital letters. A block of smaller Indonesian text follows, ending with "H.34."

In the bottom-left corner, a white rectangle contains the date "29 JULI-4 AGUSTUS 2024," the price "RP 65.000," and publication details. A barcode and QR code are also present. The background is a flat, dark gray. All elements are arranged in a vertical magazine cover format.
